It shows you a far different face when it's clear out than when there's a hurricane. Usually, it's calm and quiet, but there…

Q00154_SacrificeToTheSea/30312-07.html.text: Lighthouse Keeper Rockswell: I see that you've collected ten pelts of keltir fur. Bring them to Cristel. You can meet her at the well in front of the village warehouse. She will use the keltir fur to make yarn. Take the yarn made from keltir fur and go find Rolfe. You can meet Rolfe at the warehous…

Q00154_SacrificeToTheSea/30312-05.html.text: Lighthouse Keeper Rockswell: I see that Cristel has made the yarn. I'm always thankful to her. Give this yarn to Rolfe. You can meet Rolfe at the warehouse.

Q00154_SacrificeToTheSea/30312-06.html.text: Lighthouse Keeper Rockswell: So this is the doll that Rolfe made. He really is talented with his hands, as a famous tailor should be. The glass eyes make it seem almost alive. It won't be a problem in using it as a sacrifice to Shilen of the deep sea. Well, good work. Here is the reward as promised…
